_comment: Three parallel token bags that must produce identical OG metadata envelopes from _metadata_for. Bug 11 (failure trail 2026-06-02): _metadata_for reads bare keys; DRL emits ds-prefixed. Without normalization the ds_prefixed and mixed variants return all-null OG fields while the bare variant returns the right colors. Fixture is the regression pin. The three variants share the SAME source values for the six envelope fields {bg, surface, text, accent, font_display, font_body}; the only thing that differs is the key shape. mixed_keys carries BOTH the bare and ds-prefixed key for every field (same value under each name) so the bare-vs-namespaced normalization path inside _metadata_for is exercised on the same envelope.
